Abteilungs und Einleitungstext

For our Learning & Instructional Design department, we are looking for a Specialist Learning & Instructional Design (m/f/d) to join us full-time from November 1, 2026, on a fixed-term contract until December 31, 2027, as a parental leave replacement.

Wir bieten

Work-life balance – flexible working models, including the option to work remotely, 32 days of annual leave, and our BusinessBike program
“We statt me” – a highly collaborative, team-oriented working environment with open and honest communication
“Can-do spirit” – we are looking for people who want to make a difference and drive things forward
An inspiring work environment – with plenty of room for innovative thinking and action. Ideas and initiatives for positive change are always welcome
An international environment – with a unique and active corporate network as well as a strong partnership with our Alumni Association

Ihre Aufgabe

Design and didactic development of digital teaching offerings and learning materials in close collaboration with lecturers (e.g. online modules, self-study courses, interactive learning content)
Advising, training and supporting lecturers in the use of learning platforms and digital tools
Coordination and management of projects in the field of digital teaching (planning, implementation, quality assurance, documentation, reporting)
Strategic further development of the university’s e-learning profile and its digital teaching and learning landscape (e.g. identification of needs, development of concepts, contribution to guidelines and standards)
Analysis and evaluation of existing teaching offerings (e.g. feedback, usage data), derivation of optimisation measures and implementation of innovative teaching and learning formats

Ihr Profil

Completed university degree (e.g. Education, Educational Sciences, Media Education, Instructional Design or a comparable field)
Solid experience in the design, development and implementation of digital teaching and learning scenarios (e-learning, blended learning, online courses, learning management systems)
Good knowledge of common learning platforms (ideally Canvas) and authoring tools
German and English language skills, both written and spoken, for collaboration with lecturers, international partners and for the creation of learning materials
Project management skills, reliability and a strong sense of responsibility, as well as strong advisory skills for cooperative collaboration with lecturers, students and service units

Diversity-Hinweis (Schwerbehinderten-Hinweis)

We are looking for the best. In this, we pay special attention to personality, talent, willingness to achieve and character.
We emphasise expressly that all people - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/ideology, disability, age and sexual identity - are all equally welcome here. Applicants with disabilities who have equal professional and personal aptitude will be given priority and/or training.

Kontakt Fachabteilung

Bewerbungsaufforderung

Join our team and submit your application online, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations, quoting reference number 16617.

At CAE, we equip people in critical roles with the expertise and solutions to create a safer world. As a technology company, we digitalize the physical world, deploying software-based simulation training and critical operations support solutions. Above all else, we empower pilots, cabin crew, airlines, and defence and security forces to perform at their best every day and when the stakes are the highest. Around the globe, we’re everywhere customers need us to be with more than 13,000 employees in approximately 250 sites and training locations in over 40 countries. CAE represents more than 75 years of industry firsts—the highest-fidelity flight and mission simulators as well as training programs powered by digital technologies. We embed sustainability in everything we do. Today and tomorrow, we’ll make sure our customers are ready for the moments that matter. 

For our site in Bremen (Germany) we are looking for an

Aircraft Maintenance Specialist (f/m/d)

Key responsibilities:

- Supervision and execution of scheduled and unscheduled maintenance and servicing work
- Supervision and implementation of repair and maintenance measures as well as installation, interim and functional tests of components during retrofitting
- Troubleshooting and rectification of faults
- Disassembly and assembly of components in the areas of control, steering, drive and engine, hydraulic and de-icing systems and aircraft cabins
- Checking and approving the maintenance and repair work carried out
- Responsibility for creating documentation of the work carried out
- Technical instruction of employees within the scope of the assigned projects

Qualifications:

- Completed vocational training as an aircraft mechanic or equivalent training
- Further training EASA Part 66 CAT B1 with valid type rating for DA42 TDI and Austro
- Experience in the maintenance and repair of civil aircraft as well as in the area of base and line maintenance
- Very good written and spoken German and good English skills
- Ability to work independently and responsibly as well as a high degree of flexibility
- Enjoyment of development work
- Willingness to travel 

We offer:

- comprehensive onboarding
- the opportunity to work in international teams
- the chance to tackle complex problems and find solutions in the aviation industry
- a responsible position with excellent development opportunities

jobs.occupation: Senior Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE) - Cabin & Safety (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global leader in engineering, IT, and R&D services. Through our comprehensive 360° offering, we help clients navigate an increasingly dynamic technological and competitive landscape and shape a sustainable, smart future. Our 50,000 visionary experts worldwide drive innovation with creativity, expertise, and dedication, creating a smarter world for tomorrow.

Client Details

We are looking for experienced Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) with strong expertise in Cabin & Safety certification to support aircraft interior modification and certification programs.

You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements related to cabin safety systems, interior installations, and passenger accommodation products.

Apply now and help shape the next generation of aircraft interiors and passenger experiences. ✈️

Description

- Perform compliance verification activities for cabin and safety-related systems
- Review and approve certification documentation and compliance evidence
- Support certification activities for aircraft interior modification programs
- Ensure compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements
- Interface with seat suppliers, monument suppliers, and cabin system manufacturers
- Review TSO/ETSO qualification documentation
- Define certification strategies and means of compliance
- Support authority and customer audits

Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
- Previous experience as a CVE or Senior Certification Engineer
- Strong knowledge of:
- Cabin Safety Certification
- TSO / ETSO requirements
- EASA CS-25
- FAA Part 25
- Experience working with aircraft seat suppliers
- Strong understanding of aircraft cabin systems
- Fluent English

Job Offer

- Opportunity to work partly from home and/or remotely, benefiting from the advantages of a hybrid working model (flexible working)
- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- Wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team-building and sports events
- Global network
- Attractive employee referral program

Benefits may vary depending on the position and location. An overview of our benefits can be found on our website under Careers & Benefits.
